lines.en: I weather the cold to come spend time with my favorite alcoholic.
lines.zh: 我顶着寒冷，来陪我最爱的那个酒鬼。

lines.en: I don't know many alcoholics. In fact, I think Sara might be the only one, but I'm pretty sure she'd still be my favorite either way.
lines.zh: 我认识的酒鬼不多。事实上，Sara 大概是我认识的唯一一个；不过我想，不管怎样她都会是我的最爱。

lines.en: Why? Because she flirts with me and gives me discounts on alcohol.
lines.zh: 为什么？因为她会跟我调情，还会在酒钱上给我打折。

lines.en: Mix that with the fact that she is incredibly attractive and that there are no other males around and you have the recipe for a perfect bartender.
lines.zh: 再加上她实在好看得过分，而周围又没有别的男人——一杯完美酒保的配方就成了。

lines.en: The night proceeds with the two of us becoming mutually inebriated and, before long, Sara is unable to hold herself up any longer.
lines.zh: 那一晚我俩一起喝到上了头，没过多久，Sara 就连自己都撑不住了。

lines.en: I decide to be a good man and close the bar for her, carrying her upstairs and putting her to bed.
lines.zh: 我决定做个好人，替她把酒吧关了，把她抱上楼、放上床。

lines.en: She tries to get me to stay but, despite great temptation, I decide that she's too drunk for even me- which is saying quite a lot.
lines.zh: 她想让我留下，尽管诱惑很大，我还是觉得她醉得连我都下不去手——这话说出来分量可不轻。

lines.en: I am not a man of ethics by any means, but I do not trust my ability to form an erection for a girl who can no longer even form proper sentences.
lines.zh: 我算不上什么有道德的人，但我也不相信自己能对一个连话都说不利索的女生硬起来。

lines.en: Sara passes out the second I reject her and, not having anything else to do, I finally start heading home...
lines.zh: 我拒绝她的那一秒，Sara 就昏睡了过去；我闲着也没别的事，终于动身回家……
Sara 的好感度提升到了 [sara_love]!
